scope:
Actual SDK ESP32 QEMU gate for opt-in TLS input reclamation.

Exercise public mbedtls_calloc through its unchanged SDK platform function
pointer and linker wrapper, real observed allocator NULL under controlled heap
pressure, ordinary SDK free, native_health failed-allocation callback, queue
payload/floor protection and dual-core retirement/restore races. Four exact
source mutants require named failure plus controlled restart; panic, build
failure or timeout is never a successful detection. No physical device or
production memory/performance claim. The production option remains default off.
